function.name: NtGdiCreateCompatibleBitmap
function.description: This function creates a bitmap compatible with the device that is associated with the specified device context.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The bitmap width.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The bitmap height.

function.return_type: HBITMAP, represents a handle to the compatible bitmap if the function is successful. Otherwise, it returns zero.

function.name: NtGdiCreateBitmap
function.description: This function creates a bitmap with specified width, height, planes, bits per pixel (bpp), and bits. It validates the parameters, calculates the size and stride of the bitmap, allocates memory for the bitmap object, sets the bitmap properties, and returns a handle to the bitmap.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the bitmap.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the bitmap.

parameters.name: planes
parameters.description: The number of planes for the bitmap. This value must be 1.

parameters.name: bpp
parameters.description: The number of bits per pixel for the bitmap. Valid values are 1, 4, 8, 16, 24, and 32.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: A pointer to the bits of the bitmap.

function.return_type: HBITMAP. It represents a handle to the created bitmap. If the function fails, it returns 0 or NULL, and sets the last error to a system error code.

function.name: NtGdiGetBitmapBits
function.description: This function retrieves the bits of a specified bitmap and copies them into a buffer as a DIB using the specified format.

parameters.name: hbitmap
parameters.description: Handle to the bitmap.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of bytes to copy.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer to receive the bits.

function.return_type: LONG, represents the number of bytes copied into the buffer. If the function fails, it returns 0.

function.name: NtGdiSetBitmapBits
function.description: This function sets the bits of a specified bitmap according to the data in a buffer.

parameters.name: hbitmap
parameters.description: Handle to the bitmap.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of bytes in the bitmap array.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Address of the array with bitmap bits.

function.return_type: LONG, represents the number of bits set in the bitmap. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: NtGdiSelectBitmap
function.description: This function selects a bitmap into a device context, which can then be used for drawing. It also performs various checks and operations on the bitmap and device context.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle to the bitmap object.

function.return_type: HGDIOBJ, represents the previously selected bitmap if the function is successful. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: BITMAP_DeleteObject
function.description: This function deletes a bitmap object by freeing the associated GDI handle and the memory allocated for the bitmap object.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This parameter is a handle to the GDI object that needs to be deleted.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the bitmap object was successfully deleted, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: BITMAP_GetObject
function.description: This function retrieves information for the specified graphics object.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle to the graphics object

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of bytes of information to be written to the buffer

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that receives the information about the graphics object

function.return_type: INT, represents the number of bytes written to the buffer. If the buffer is null, return the size of the object in bytes.

function.name: NtGdiGetBitmapDimension
function.description: This function retrieves the dimensions of a specified bitmap. It returns a boolean value indicating the success or failure of the operation.

parameters.name: hbitmap
parameters.description: Handle to the bitmap whose dimensions are to be retrieved.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Address of a structure that will receive the dimensions of the bitmap.

function.return_type: BOOL, where TRUE indicates that the function successfully retrieved the bitmap dimensions and FALSE indicates a failure in retrieving the dimensions.

function.name: NtGdiSetBitmapDimension
function.description: This function sets the dimensions of a bitmap. If the 'prevSize' parameter is not NULL, the function places the previous dimensions of the bitmap into the SIZE structure pointed to by 'prevSize'.

parameters.name: hbitmap
parameters.description: Handle to the bitmap whose dimensions are to be set.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The new width of the bitmap.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The new height of the bitmap.

parameters.name: prevSize
parameters.description: Pointer to a SIZE structure that will receive the previous dimensions of the bitmap. This parameter can be NULL.

function.return_type: BOOL. The function returns TRUE if successful, or FALSE otherwise.
